description: This file defines the AWS EKSClient class for interacting with the Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS). It includes method annotations for various EKS operations, both synchronous and asynchronous, and extends the general AwsClient class. The file provides the class and method definitions necessary for client-side SDK calls to the EKS API.

classes.name: EKSClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) via AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: associateAccessPolicy
methods.description: Associates an access policy to an EKS resource.

methods.name: associateAccessPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates an access policy to an EKS resource.

methods.name: describeCluster
methods.description: Retrieves details about an existing EKS cluster.

methods.name: listClusters
methods.description: Lists all EKS clusters in the account.

methods.name: updateClusterConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration of an existing EKS cluster.
